name: Dren
found: The Oil Pits, stinking of fish oil.
appearance: Young, thin, stained with fish oil.
sayings: Seven more years. I count them.
dreams: Escape to Nebruz to work bog iron, and never see a fish again.
oddly_also: Drinks stolen wine and imagines the oil pits burning.
family: Inherited his dead father's debt; his siblings scattered.
